variants.baseline_observer: Original regret and averaging updates; observation instrumentation only
variants.theta_one: Same instrumentation; only averaging multiplier changed from theta=0.9 to 1.0

build.checkpoint_instrumentation: Capture source metric, average policy and current policy immediately after the same completed iteration

set_effective_stack 100
set_board 2c,3d,4h,8s,9c
set_range_oop KK
set_range_ip AA,KK:0.5,QJo:0.5
set_bet_sizes oop,river,bet,100
set_bet_sizes ip,river,bet,100
set_bet_sizes oop,river,raise
set_bet_sizes ip,river,raise
set_allin_threshold 100
build_tree
set_thread_num 1
set_accuracy -1
set_max_iteration 40000
set_print_interval 4000
set_use_isomorphism 0
start_solve
